sentences.text:
2024 
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.508 Of 2024
O R D E R:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 seeking anticipatory bail in the event of their arrest in connection with unregistered crime proposed to be filed on the file of the Keesara Police Station, Medchal-Malkajgiri District.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State and perused the record.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that there are differences between the 1st petitioner and his wife.
The wife lodged a complaint to the police and the police are calling the petitioners.

4. Since the apprehension is on the basis of a complaint being lodged by the 1st petitioner's wife and the allegations levelled against the petitioners attract the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC along with other offences, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously, in the event of registering the crime for the offences punishable up to seven years.

5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed off.

Miscellaneous applications pending, if any,
shall stand closed.
